articles.title: UK homeowners: has the hot weather damaged your property?
articles.snippet: Are you dealing with subsidence or other issues caused by the hot weather? During a dry spell, such as the successive heatwaves that affected some parts of the UK this year, houses built on clay-rich soil suffer as moisture is sucked away by trees and bushes. This causes the clay to shrink and foundations to drop, causing structural problems. We would like to speak to homeowners who are dealing with damage to their homes which is likely to have been caused by this year’s extremely hot, dry weather. Continue reading...

articles.snippet: De gemeente Balen wil zo snel mogelijk een oplossing voor de waterproblemen aan de Zillendijk. Dat is de gemeentelijke weg die door het natuurgebied Scheps loopt, en ook deel uitmaakt van het toeristische fietsnetwerk.
